decisions.reason: As a bread product very close to the core bakery range, it fits the firm's traditional offer and would usually be retained unless clearly unsuccessful, especially with no visible evidence of failure.

The guided historic mill tour extends the firm's heritage and hospitality positioning, likely involved visible commitment of facilities and marketing, and under escalation of commitment management would be reluctant to withdraw it quickly.

A sweet pastry is strongly aligned with the confectionery business and uses existing craft capabilities, so management would tend to keep it on offer rather than reverse a recent launch without strong negative signals.
